steps.title: Строки, regex и оконная аналитика
steps.content:
## Строки и аналитика

- **`REGEXP`** в приложении — **JavaScript**-регулярка (регистрозависимая): `^…$`, `[0-9]{4}`, `\b` (граница слова).
- Даты хранятся как `TEXT` (`YYYY-MM-DD`), сравниваются лексикографически; разница в днях — `julianday(a) - julianday(b)`.
- Неделя: `strftime('%Y-%W', d)`; время суток — `substr(ts, 12, 5)`.
- «Интервалы подряд» — приём `date(action_date, '-' || ROW_NUMBER() … || ' days')`: одинаковая метка у последовательных дней.
- `GLOB` проверяет по маске и возвращает 0/1: `x GLOB '[A-Za-z]'`, `x NOT GLOB '*[^A-Za-z]*'`.

steps.title: Схема: Strings, Regex and Behavioral Analytics

content.description:
Валидный email: ровно один `@`, локальная часть из букв/цифр/`_`, домен только из букв и заканчивается на `.com`. Колонки `user_id`, `email`; сортировка по `user_id`.

[LeetCode 3436](https://leetcode.com/problems/find-valid-emails/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Users(user_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, email TEXT NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT user_id, email FROM Users WHERE email REGEXP '^.+@[A-Za-z]+\.com$' ORDER BY user_id;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT user_id, email FROM Users WHERE email REGEXP '^[A-Za-z0-9_]+@[A-Za-z]+\.com$' ORDER BY user_id;

steps.title: 3465. Find Products with Valid Serial Numbers

content.description:
Товары, в описании которых есть серийный номер вида `SN` + ровно 4 цифры + `-` + ровно 4 цифры (границы слова). Колонки `product_id`, `product_name`, `description`; сортировка по `product_id`.

[LeetCode 3465](https://leetcode.com/problems/find-products-with-valid-serial-numbers/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE products(product_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, product_name TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT product_id, product_name, description FROM products WHERE description LIKE '%SN____-____%' ORDER BY product_id;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT product_id, product_name, description FROM products WHERE description REGEXP '\bSN[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{4}\b' ORDER BY product_id;

content.description:
Для каждой последовательности верните `sample_id`, `dna_sequence`, `species` и флаги: `has_start` (начинается с `ATG`), `has_stop` (заканчивается `TAA`/`TAG`/`TGA`), `has_atat` (содержит `ATAT`), `has_ggg` (есть ≥ 3 подряд `G`). Сортировка по `sample_id`.

[LeetCode 3475](https://leetcode.com/problems/dna-pattern-recognition/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Samples(sample_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, dna_sequence TEXT NOT NULL, species TEXT NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT sample_id, dna_sequence, species, dna_sequence LIKE 'ATG%' AS has_start, dna_sequence LIKE '%TAA%' AS has_stop, dna_sequence LIKE '%ATAT%' AS has_atat, dna_sequence LIKE '%GGG%' AS has_ggg FROM Samples ORDER BY sample_id;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT sample_id, dna_sequence, species, dna_sequence LIKE 'ATG%' AS has_start, dna_sequence REGEXP 'TAA$|TAG$|TGA$' AS has_stop, dna_sequence LIKE '%ATAT%' AS has_atat, dna_sequence REGEXP 'GGG' AS has_ggg FROM Samples ORDER BY sample_id;

content.description:
Преобразуйте каждое слово `content_text`: если слово начинается не с английской буквы — без изменений; если это 2+ части из английских букв через `-` — каждую часть с заглавной; иначе — первая буква заглавная, остальные строчные. Колонки `content_id`, `original_text`, `converted_text`.

[LeetCode 3374](https://leetcode.com/problems/first-letter-capitalization-ii/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE user_content(content_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, content_text TEXT NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT content_id, content_text AS original_text, UPPER(SUBSTR(content_text, 1, 1)) || LOWER(SUBSTR(content_text, 2)) AS converted_text FROM user_content ORDER BY content_id;
content.referenceSolution:
WITH RECURSIVE splitwords(content_id, idx, word, rest) AS (SELECT content_id, 1, CASE WHEN instr(content_text, ' ') = 0 THEN content_text ELSE substr(content_text, 1, instr(content_text, ' ') - 1) END, CASE WHEN instr(content_text, ' ') = 0 THEN '' ELSE substr(content_text, instr(content_text, ' ') + 1) END FROM user_content
UNION ALL SELECT content_id, idx + 1, CASE WHEN instr(rest, ' ') = 0 THEN rest ELSE substr(rest, 1, instr(rest, ' ') - 1) END, CASE WHEN instr(rest, ' ') = 0 THEN '' ELSE substr(rest, instr(rest, ' ') + 1) END FROM splitwords WHERE rest <> ''),
parts(content_id, idx, part_idx, part, rest) AS (SELECT content_id, idx, 1, CASE WHEN instr(word, '-') = 0 THEN word ELSE substr(word, 1, instr(word, '-') - 1) END, CASE WHEN instr(word, '-') = 0 THEN '' ELSE substr(word, instr(word, '-') + 1) END FROM splitwords
UNION ALL SELECT content_id, idx, part_idx + 1, CASE WHEN instr(rest, '-') = 0 THEN rest ELSE substr(rest, 1, instr(rest, '-') - 1) END, CASE WHEN instr(rest, '-') = 0 THEN '' ELSE substr(rest, instr(rest, '-') + 1) END FROM parts WHERE rest <> ''),
hyphen(content_id, idx, part_idx, acc) AS (SELECT content_id, idx, 1, UPPER(SUBSTR(part, 1, 1)) || LOWER(SUBSTR(part, 2)) FROM parts WHERE part_idx = 1
UNION ALL SELECT p.content_id, p.idx, p.part_idx, h.acc || '-' || UPPER(SUBSTR(p.part, 1, 1)) || LOWER(SUBSTR(p.part, 2)) FROM hyphen h JOIN parts p ON p.content_id = h.content_id AND p.idx = h.idx AND p.part_idx = h.part_idx + 1),
wordinfo AS (SELECT w.content_id, w.idx, w.word, COUNT(p.part_idx) AS part_count, MAX(CASE WHEN p.part_idx = 1 AND SUBSTR(p.part, 1, 1) GLOB '[A-Za-z]' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS starts_letter, MIN(CASE WHEN p.part <> '' AND p.part NOT GLOB '*[^A-Za-z]*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS all_letters FROM splitwords w JOIN parts p ON p.content_id = w.content_id AND p.idx = w.idx GROUP BY w.content_id, w.idx),
converted AS (SELECT content_id, idx, CASE WHEN starts_letter = 0 THEN word WHEN all_letters = 1 AND part_count >= 2 THEN (SELECT acc FROM hyphen h WHERE h.content_id = wordinfo.content_id AND h.idx = wordinfo.idx ORDER BY h.part_idx DESC LIMIT 1) ELSE UPPER(SUBSTR(word, 1, 1)) || LOWER(SUBSTR(word, 2)) END AS conv FROM wordinfo),
built(content_id, idx, out) AS (SELECT content_id, idx, conv FROM converted WHERE idx = 1
UNION ALL SELECT b.content_id, c.idx, b.out || ' ' || c.conv FROM built b JOIN converted c ON c.content_id = b.content_id AND c.idx = b.idx + 1)
SELECT uc.content_id, uc.content_text AS original_text, COALESCE((SELECT out FROM built b WHERE b.content_id = uc.content_id ORDER BY b.idx DESC LIMIT 1), '') AS converted_text FROM user_content uc ORDER BY uc.content_id;

content.description:
Невалидный IPv4: не 4 октета, октет > 255 или октет с ведущим нулём. Колонки `ip`, `invalid_count`; сортировка по `invalid_count` и `ip` убыв.

[LeetCode 3451](https://leetcode.com/problems/find-invalid-ip-addresses/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE logs(log_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, ip TEXT NOT NULL, status_code INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT ip, COUNT(*) AS invalid_count FROM logs WHERE length(ip) - length(replace(ip, '.', '')) <> 3 GROUP BY ip ORDER BY invalid_count DESC, ip DESC;
content.referenceSolution:
WITH RECURSIVE split(log_id, ip, octet, rest, cnt) AS (SELECT log_id, ip, CASE WHEN instr(ip, '.') = 0 THEN ip ELSE substr(ip, 1, instr(ip, '.') - 1) END, CASE WHEN instr(ip, '.') = 0 THEN '' ELSE substr(ip, instr(ip, '.') + 1) END, CASE WHEN instr(ip, '.') = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END FROM logs
UNION ALL SELECT log_id, ip, CASE WHEN instr(rest, '.') = 0 THEN rest ELSE substr(rest, 1, instr(rest, '.') - 1) END, CASE WHEN instr(rest, '.') = 0 THEN '' ELSE substr(rest, instr(rest, '.') + 1) END, cnt + 1 FROM split WHERE rest <> ''),
per_ip AS (SELECT log_id, ip, COUNT(*) AS octets, SUM(CASE WHEN octet = '' OR octet GLOB '*[^0-9]*' OR octet GLOB '0*[0-9]*' OR CAST(octet AS INTEGER) > 255 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad FROM split GROUP BY log_id)
SELECT ip, COUNT(*) AS invalid_count FROM per_ip WHERE octets <> 4 OR bad > 0 OR substr(ip, -1) = '.' GROUP BY ip ORDER BY invalid_count DESC, ip DESC;

content.description:
Пациенты, у которых был положительный тест, а позже — отрицательный: `patient_id`, `patient_name`, `age`, `recovery_time` (дней от **первого** положительного до **первого** следующего отрицательного). Сортировка: `recovery_time` возр., имя возр.

[LeetCode 3586](https://leetcode.com/problems/find-covid-recovery-patients/)
content.setup:
CREATE TABLE patients(patient_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, patient_name TEXT NOT NULL, age INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE covid_tests(test_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, patient_id INTEGER NOT NULL, test_date TEXT NOT NULL, result TEXT NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT p.patient_id, p.patient_name, p.age, 0 AS recovery_time FROM patients p JOIN covid_tests t ON t.patient_id = p.patient_id GROUP BY p.patient_id ORDER BY recovery_time, p.patient_name;

content.description:
Сотрудники, у которых **больше 50%** рабочей недели (40 ч) уходит на встречи: суммарно **> 20 ч** за календарную неделю (Пн–Вс), таких недель **≥ 2**. Колонки `employee_id`, `employee_name`, `department`, `meeting_heavy_weeks`. Сортировка: недели убыв., имя возр.

[LeetCode 3611](https://leetcode.com/problems/find-overbooked-employees/)
content.setup:
CREATE TABLE employees(employee_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, employee_name TEXT NOT NULL, department TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE meetings(meeting_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, employee_id INTEGER NOT NULL, meeting_date TEXT NOT NULL, meeting_type TEXT NOT NULL, duration_hours REAL NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT e.employee_id, e.employee_name, e.department, COUNT(*) AS meeting_heavy_weeks FROM meetings m JOIN employees e ON e.employee_id = m.employee_id WHERE m.duration_hours > 20 GROUP BY e.employee_id ORDER BY meeting_heavy_weeks DESC, e.employee_name;
content.referenceSolution:
WITH weekly AS (SELECT employee_id, strftime('%Y-%W', meeting_date) AS wk, SUM(duration_hours) AS hours FROM meetings GROUP BY employee_id, wk)
SELECT e.employee_id, e.employee_name, e.department, COUNT(*) AS meeting_heavy_weeks FROM weekly w JOIN employees e ON e.employee_id = w.employee_id WHERE w.hours > 20 GROUP BY e.employee_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY meeting_heavy_weeks DESC, e.employee_name;

steps.title: 3617. Find Students with Study Spiral Pattern

content.description:
Студенты, которые изучают ≥ 3 разных предмета повторяющимся циклом (минимум 2 полных цикла, ≥ 6 сессий), причём все соседние сессии идут без разрыва больше 2 дней. Колонки `student_id`, `student_name`, `major`, `cycle_length`, `total_study_hours`. Сортировка: `cycle_length` убыв., часы убыв.

[LeetCode 3617](https://leetcode.com/problems/find-students-with-study-spiral-pattern/)
content.setup:
CREATE TABLE students(student_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, student_name TEXT NOT NULL, major TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE study_sessions(session_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, student_id INTEGER NOT NULL, subject TEXT NOT NULL, session_date TEXT NOT NULL, hours_studied REAL NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT s.student_id, s.student_name, s.major, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.subject) AS cycle_length, SUM(ss.hours_studied) AS total_study_hours FROM students s JOIN study_sessions ss ON ss.student_id = s.student_id GROUP BY s.student_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ss.subject) >= 3 ORDER BY cycle_length DESC, total_study_hours DESC;
content.referenceSolution:
WITH ranked AS (SELECT student_id, session_id, session_date, subject, hours_studied, julianday(session_date) - julianday(LAG(session_date) OVER (PARTITION BY student_id ORDER BY session_date, session_id)) AS gap, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY student_id ORDER BY session_date, session_id) AS idx FROM study_sessions),
contig AS (SELECT student_id FROM ranked GROUP BY student_id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN gap > 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0),
stats AS (SELECT r.student_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT r.subject) AS k FROM ranked r JOIN contig c ON c.student_id = r.student_id GROUP BY r.student_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.subject) >= 3 AND COUNT(*) >= 2 * COUNT(DISTINCT r.subject) AND COUNT(*) % COUNT(DISTINCT r.subject) = 0),
good AS (SELECT st.student_id, st.k FROM stats st WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ranked cur JOIN ranked cyc ON cyc.student_id = cur.student_id AND cyc.idx = ((cur.idx - 1) % st.k) + 1 WHERE cur.student_id = st.student_id AND cur.subject <> cyc.subject))
SELECT s.student_id, s.student_name, s.major, g.k AS cycle_length, ROUND((SELECT SUM(r.hours_studied) FROM ranked r WHERE r.student_id = g.student_id), 2) AS total_study_hours FROM good g JOIN students s ON s.student_id = g.student_id ORDER BY cycle_length DESC, total_study_hours DESC;

content.description:
Магазины (≥ 3 товара), где количество **самого дорогого** товара меньше, чем **самого дешёвого**: колонки `store_id`, `store_name`, `location`, `most_exp_product`, `cheapest_product`, `imbalance_ratio` (округлить до 2). Сортировка: ratio убыв., имя магазина возр.

[LeetCode 3626](https://leetcode.com/problems/find-stores-with-inventory-imbalance/)
content.setup:
CREATE TABLE stores(store_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, store_name TEXT NOT NULL, location TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE inventory(inventory_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, store_id INTEGER NOT NULL, product_name TEXT NOT NULL, quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, price REAL NOT NULL);
content.starterCode:
WITH t AS (SELECT store_id, product_name, quantity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY price DESC, quantity DESC) AS rk_exp, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY price ASC, quantity DESC) AS rk_cheap, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id) AS cnt FROM inventory)
SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, s.location, e.product_name AS most_exp_product, c.product_name AS cheapest_product, ROUND(c.quantity * 1.0 / e.quantity, 2) AS imbalance_ratio FROM t e JOIN t c ON c.store_id = e.store_id AND c.rk_cheap = 1 JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = e.store_id WHERE e.rk_exp = 1 ORDER BY imbalance_ratio DESC, s.store_name;
content.referenceSolution:
WITH t AS (SELECT store_id, product_name, quantity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY price DESC, quantity DESC) AS rk_exp, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY price ASC, quantity DESC) AS rk_cheap, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id) AS cnt FROM inventory)
SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, s.location, e.product_name AS most_exp_product, c.product_name AS cheapest_product, ROUND(c.quantity * 1.0 / e.quantity, 2) AS imbalance_ratio FROM t e JOIN t c ON c.store_id = e.store_id AND c.rk_cheap = 1 JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = e.store_id WHERE e.rk_exp = 1 AND e.cnt >= 3 AND e.quantity < c.quantity ORDER BY imbalance_ratio DESC, s.store_name;

content.description:
Книги (≥ 5 сессий) с оценками и ≥ 4, и ≤ 2, где доля крайних оценок (≤ 2 или ≥ 4) **≥ 0.6**: колонки `book_id`, `title`, `author`, `genre`, `pages`, `rating_spread`, `polarization_score` (округлить до 2). Сортировка: score убыв., title убыв.

[LeetCode 3642](https://leetcode.com/problems/find-books-with-polarized-opinions/)
content.setup:
CREATE TABLE books(book_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL, author TEXT NOT NULL, genre TEXT NOT NULL, pages INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE reading_sessions(session_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, book_id INTEGER NOT NULL, reader_name TEXT NOT NULL, pages_read INTEGER NOT NULL, session_rating INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT b.book_id, b.title, b.author, b.genre, b.pages, MAX(s.session_rating) - MIN(s.session_rating) AS rating_spread, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN s.session_rating <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN s.session_rating >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS polarization_score FROM books b JOIN reading_sessions s ON s.book_id = b.book_id GROUP BY b.book_id ORDER BY polarization_score DESC, b.title DESC;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT b.book_id, b.title, b.author, b.genre, b.pages, MAX(s.session_rating) - MIN(s.session_rating) AS rating_spread, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN s.session_rating <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN s.session_rating >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS polarization_score FROM books b JOIN reading_sessions s ON s.book_id = b.book_id GROUP BY b.book_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 AND MAX(s.session_rating) >= 4 AND MIN(s.session_rating) <= 2 AND 5 * (SUM(CASE WHEN s.session_rating <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN s.session_rating >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) >= 3 * COUNT(*) ORDER BY polarization_score DESC, b.title DESC;

content.description:
Лояльные клиенты: ≥ 3 покупки, активность ≥ 30 дней и доля возвратов < 20%. Колонка `customer_id`, сортировка по возрастанию.

[LeetCode 3657](https://leetcode.com/problems/find-loyal-customers/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE customer_transactions(transaction_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL, transaction_date TEXT NOT NULL, amount REAL NOT NULL, transaction_type TEXT NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT customer_id FROM customer_transactions GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 AND SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'refund' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) < 0.2 ORDER BY customer_id;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT customer_id FROM customer_transactions GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 AND SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'refund' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) < 0.2 AND (julianday(MAX(transaction_date)) - julianday(MIN(transaction_date))) >= 30 ORDER BY customer_id;

content.description:
«Зомби-сессии»: длительность **> 30** минут, ≥ 5 `scroll`, отношение `click`/`scroll` **< 0.20**, ни одной покупки. Колонки `session_id`, `user_id`, `session_duration_minutes`, `scroll_count`. Сортировка: scroll убыв., `session_id` возр.

[LeetCode 3673](https://leetcode.com/problems/find-zombie-sessions/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE app_events(event_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, event_timestamp TEXT NOT NULL, event_type TEXT NOT NULL, session_id TEXT NOT NULL, event_value INTEGER);
content.starterCode: SELECT session_id, user_id, CAST(ROUND((julianday(MAX(event_timestamp)) - julianday(MIN(event_timestamp))) * 1440) AS INTEGER) AS session_duration_minutes, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'scroll' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS scroll_count FROM app_events GROUP BY session_id, user_id HAVING (julianday(MAX(event_timestamp)) - julianday(MIN(event_timestamp))) * 1440 > 30 AND SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'scroll' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 5 ORDER BY scroll_count DESC, session_id;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT session_id, user_id, CAST(ROUND((julianday(MAX(event_timestamp)) - julianday(MIN(event_timestamp))) * 1440) AS INTEGER) AS session_duration_minutes, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'scroll' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS scroll_count FROM app_events GROUP BY session_id, user_id HAVING (julianday(MAX(event_timestamp)) - julianday(MIN(event_timestamp))) * 1440 > 30 AND SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'click' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'scroll' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 0.2 AND SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'purchase' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'scroll' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 5 ORDER BY scroll_count DESC, session_id;

content.description:
«Золотые» клиенты: ≥ 3 заказа, ≥ 60% заказов в часы пик (`11:00`–`14:00` или `18:00`–`21:00`), средняя оценка оценённых заказов ≥ 4.0 и оценено ≥ 50% заказов. Колонки `customer_id`, `total_orders`, `peak_hour_percentage`, `average_rating`. Сортировка: рейтинг убыв., `customer_id` убыв.

[LeetCode 3705](https://leetcode.com/problems/find-golden-hour-customers/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE restaurant_orders(order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL, order_timestamp TEXT NOT NULL, order_amount REAL NOT NULL, payment_method TEXT NOT NULL, order_rating INTEGER);
content.starterCode: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS total_orders, CAST(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(order_timestamp, 12, 5) BETWEEN '11:00' AND '14:00' OR substr(order_timestamp, 12, 5) BETWEEN '18:00' AND '21:00' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 0) AS INTEGER) AS peak_hour_percentage, ROUND(AVG(order_rating), 2) AS average_rating FROM restaurant_orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 AND SUM(CASE WHEN substr(order_timestamp, 12, 5) BETWEEN '11:00' AND '14:00' OR substr(order_timestamp, 12, 5) BETWEEN '18:00' AND '21:00' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 5 >= 3 * COUNT(*) AND AVG(order_rating) >= 4.0 ORDER BY average_rating DESC, customer_id DESC;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS total_orders, CAST(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(order_timestamp, 12, 5) BETWEEN '11:00' AND '14:00' OR substr(order_timestamp, 12, 5) BETWEEN '18:00' AND '21:00' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 0) AS INTEGER) AS peak_hour_percentage, ROUND(AVG(order_rating), 2) AS average_rating FROM restaurant_orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 AND SUM(CASE WHEN substr(order_timestamp, 12, 5) BETWEEN '11:00' AND '14:00' OR substr(order_timestamp, 12, 5) BETWEEN '18:00' AND '21:00' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 5 >= 3 * COUNT(*) AND AVG(order_rating) >= 4.0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN order_rating IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) >= 0.5 ORDER BY average_rating DESC, customer_id DESC;

steps.title: 3793. Find Users with High Token Usage

content.description:
По каждому `user_id`: `prompt_count` и `avg_tokens` (округлить до 2). Только пользователи с ≥ 3 промптами, у которых есть промпт с числом токенов выше собственного среднего. Сортировка: среднее убыв., `user_id` возр.

[LeetCode 3793](https://leetcode.com/problems/find-users-with-high-token-usage/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE prompts(user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, prompt TEXT NOT NULL, tokens INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(user_id, prompt));
content.starterCode: SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS prompt_count, ROUND(AVG(tokens), 2) AS avg_tokens FROM prompts GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ORDER BY avg_tokens DESC, user_id;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS prompt_count, ROUND(AVG(tokens), 2) AS avg_tokens FROM prompts GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 AND MAX(tokens) > AVG(tokens) ORDER BY avg_tokens DESC, user_id;

content.description:
Пользователи с ≥ 5 реакциями, у которых **≥ 60%** реакций одного типа: колонки `user_id`, `dominant_reaction`, `reaction_ratio` (округлить до 2). Сортировка: ratio убыв., `user_id` возр.

[LeetCode 3808](https://leetcode.com/problems/find-emotionally-consistent-users/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE reactions(user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, content_id INTEGER NOT NULL, reaction TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(user_id, content_id));
content.starterCode:
WITH t AS (SELECT user_id, reaction, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM reactions GROUP BY user_id, reaction)
SELECT t.user_id, t.reaction AS dominant_reaction, ROUND(t.cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM (SELECT user_id, reaction, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM reactions GROUP BY user_id, reaction) x WHERE x.user_id = t.user_id), 2) AS reaction_ratio FROM t ORDER BY reaction_ratio DESC, t.user_id;

steps.title: 3832. Find Users with Persistent Behavior Patterns

content.description:
Самый длинный интервал (≥ 5 дней) подряд, где у пользователя **ровно одно** действие в день и одно и то же действие каждый день: `user_id`, `action`, `streak_length`, `start_date`, `end_date`. Сортировка: длина убыв., `user_id` возр.

[LeetCode 3832](https://leetcode.com/problems/find-users-with-persistent-behavior-patterns/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE activity(user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, action_date TEXT NOT NULL, action TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(user_id, action_date, action));
content.starterCode:
WITH grp AS (SELECT user_id, action, action_date, date(action_date, '-' || ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id, action ORDER BY action_date) || ' days') AS g FROM activity)
SELECT user_id, action, COUNT(*) AS streak_length, MIN(action_date) AS start_date, MAX(action_date) AS end_date FROM grp GROUP BY user_id, action, g HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ORDER BY streak_length DESC, user_id;
content.referenceSolution:
WITH single AS (SELECT user_id, action_date, action FROM activity WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity a2 WHERE a2.user_id = activity.user_id AND a2.action_date = activity.action_date) = 1),
grp AS (SELECT user_id, action, action_date, date(action_date, '-' || ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id, action ORDER BY action_date) || ' days') AS g FROM single),
streaks AS (SELECT user_id, action, COUNT(*) AS streak_length, MIN(action_date) AS start_date, MAX(action_date) AS end_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM grp GROUP BY user_id, action, g HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5)
SELECT user_id, action, streak_length, start_date, end_date FROM streaks WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY streak_length DESC, user_id;
